items.name: Annual mapping of soil organic carbon stock in Brazil 1985-2021 (beta collection). Map collection
items.description: Series of raster maps of the soil (0-30 cm) organic carbon stock across Brazil, covering the period 1985-2021, with temporal resolution of one year and spatial resolution of 30 m. The maps were produced using 9650 field soil samples and 43 static and dynamic covariates.
